description.zh:
待检测的图像URL地址。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个图片检测任务结构体（image表）。最多支持10个元素，即同时最多对10张图片进行检测。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。

> 对于该接口，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费。
description.en:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image table). A maximum of 10 elements are supported, meaning up to 10 images can be detected simultaneously. We recommend using OSS links in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or with OSS links in non-Shanghai regions, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).

> For this API, the system automatically converts OSS link addresses to internal network addresses before downloading files, so calling this API does not incur OSS traffic charges.

descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
人脸活体检测能力可以检测图像中的人脸是否为来自认证设备端的近距离裸拍活体人脸对象，可广泛应用在人脸实时采集场景，满足人脸注册认证的真实性和安全性要求。活体判断的前置条件是图像中有人脸。
能力范围来看：
1. 认证设备端是指借助近距离裸拍活体正面人脸用于认证、通行等服务场景的含RGB摄像头的硬件设备，常见的认证设备端有手机、门禁机、考勤机、PC等智能终端认证设备。
2. 裸拍活体正面人脸是指真人未经重度PS、风格化、人工合成等后处理的含正面人脸（非模糊、遮挡、大角度的正面人脸）的照片。常见的非真人有纸张人脸、电子屏人脸等；常见经过重度PS后处理的照片有摆拍街景照、摆拍人物风景照、摆拍证件照等；常见的其他后处理及生成照片有动漫人脸、绘画人脸等。

> - 在同时检测多个Task的情况下，将按照Task的个数进行累计计费。
- 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 当前能力可在视觉智能开放平台有完整的免费产品体验，您可以单击[立即试用](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DetectLivingFace)对该能力进行更直观试用以及在线购买。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 应用场景
- 系统人脸登录防攻击：通过检测上传的图像是否为真人实拍，而非攻击及PS等后处理照片，以防止攻击者登录系统带来安全风险。
- 门禁闸机刷脸通行：面向人脸注册和认证环节设备端实时的活体检测，实现注册与认证过程中的真人校验，防止非法分子盗用、伪造他人身份打卡通行。
- 智慧酒店自助入住：在酒店前台自助办理入住场景中，运用活体检测技术实现无人监管场景下，住客非活体攻击（纸张人脸、电子屏人脸）的高效率拦截。
- 金融远程身份认证：面向投资理财、基金交易、保险理赔等金融业务的活体检测需求，高效率实现对翻拍、PS图片、打印图片、高仿模具等攻击的拦截，确保用户身份真实。

## 特色优势
- 基于图片中人像目标的高维度特征（风格化、摩尔纹、成像畸形等），判断目标对象是否为活体，有效防止屏幕二次翻拍等作弊攻击，支持单张或多张判断逻辑。
- 灵活支持RGB摄像头设备的实时活体检测，可有效防止翻拍、头模、打印图片等样本攻击。
- 简单易用：可直接调用的API接口，服务简单易用，易被集成，兼容性强。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：请确保您已开通[人脸人体服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open)。
> 本能力支持企业或个人认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/DetectLivingFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22Tasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FDetectLivingFace%2FDetectLivingFace1.jpg%22%7D%5D%7D&tab=DEMO)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
5. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 示例代码：该能力常用语言的示例代码，请参见[人脸活体检测示例代码](~~465556~~)。

7. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 输入限制
- 图像格式：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、WEBP。
- 图像大小：不超过10 MB。
- 图像分辨率：建议大于256×256像素，像素过低可能会影响识别效果。
- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

> 当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见[图片缩放](~~44688~~)。

## 检测说明

- 最长检测时间是5秒，如果在该时间内没有完成检测，系统会强制返回超时错误码。
- 图像下载时间限制为3秒，如果下载时间超过3秒，系统会返回下载超时。
- 图像检测接口响应时间依赖图像的下载时间。请保证被检测图像所在的存储服务稳定可靠，建议您使用阿里云OSS存储或者CDN缓存。
- 最多可检测10张图像。
- 目前平台提供的活体检测为静默活体，即基于图片进行检测，暂不支持摇头，张嘴、眨眼等动作的活体检测。

## 计费说明
关于人脸活体检测的计费方式及报价，请参见[计费介绍](~~184049~~)。

> 下方调试接口为付费接口，如需免费体验调试请前往[体验中心](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DetectLivingFace)。
descriptions.en:
## Feature Description
The Face Liveness Detection feature can detect whether a face in an image is a live face object directly captured from an authentication device at close range. It can be widely used in real-time face capture scenarios to meet the authenticity and security requirements of face registration and authentication. A prerequisite for liveness detection is the presence of a face in the image.
In terms of capability scope:
1. An authentication device refers to a hardware device with an RGB camera that uses close-range, directly captured live frontal face images for authentication, access control, and other service scenarios. Common authentication devices include smartphones, access control machines, attendance machines, PCs, and other smart terminal authentication devices.
2. A directly captured live frontal face refers to a photo of a real person's frontal face (non-blurred, non-occluded, non-large-angle frontal face) that has not undergone heavy post-processing such as Photoshop editing, stylization, or artificial synthesis. Common non-real-person examples include paper face photos and electronic screen face photos. Common heavily post-processed photos include posed street scene photos, posed portrait landscape photos, and posed ID photos. Other post-processed and generated photos include anime faces, painted faces, etc.

> - When detecting multiple Tasks simultaneously, billing is accumulated based on the number of Tasks.
- You can access [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) for online assistance.
- This feature is available for a complete free trial on the Visual Intelligence Open Platform. You can click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DetectLivingFace) for a more intuitive trial and online purchase.
- For API integration, interface usage, or consultation regarding Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform visual AI capabilities, please contact us through DingTalk group (23109592) by joining the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform consultation group.

## Use Cases
- System face login anti-attack: By detecting whether the uploaded image is a real person's live capture rather than an attack or post-processed photo, it prevents attackers from logging into the system and causing security risks.
- Access control and gate face scanning: Provides real-time liveness detection at the device end during face registration and authentication, enabling real-person verification during registration and authentication processes and preventing unauthorized individuals from using stolen or forged identities for check-in and access.
- Smart hotel self-service check-in: In the self-service check-in scenario at hotel front desks, liveness detection technology enables efficient interception of non-live attacks (paper face photos, electronic screen face photos) in unattended scenarios.
- Financial remote identity authentication: For liveness detection requirements in financial services such as investment and wealth management, fund trading, and insurance claims, it efficiently intercepts attacks from recaptured photos, Photoshop-edited images, printed photos, and high-fidelity models to ensure user identity authenticity.

## Key Advantages
- Based on high-dimensional features (stylization, moire patterns, imaging distortion, etc.) of the face target in the image, it determines whether the target object is a live face, effectively preventing screen recapture and other spoofing attacks, and supports single or multiple image judgment logic.
- Flexibly supports real-time liveness detection for RGB camera devices, effectively preventing recaptured photos, head models, printed photos, and other sample attacks.
- Easy to use: Directly callable API interface, simple and easy to use, easy to integrate, and highly compatible.

## Integration Guide
1. Register an Alibaba Cloud account: Open the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Register Now** in the upper-right corner, and follow the instructions to complete account registration.
2. Activate the feature: Please ensure that you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, please [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).
> This feature supports activation by enterprise or individually verified users. For more information about real-name verification, see [Real-Name Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
3. Create an AccessKey: Please ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you need to grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/DetectLivingFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22Tasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FDetectLivingFace%2FDetectLivingFace1.jpg%22%7D%5D%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug the feature online, view complete call sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
5. Development integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use in [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).
- Find the SDK package with the AI category set to Face and Body (facebody) in the corresponding language SDK documentation and install it.
- Refer to the sample code provided in the documentation, make appropriate modifications, and call the API.

6. Sample code: For sample code in commonly used languages for this feature, see [Face Liveness Detection Sample Code](~~465556~~).

7. Client-side direct calling: Common client-side calling methods for this feature include the following.
- [Web Frontend Direct Calling](~~467779~~)
- [Mini Program Direct Calling](~~467780~~)
- [Android Direct Calling](~~467781~~)
- [iOS Direct Calling](~~467782~~)

## Input Limits
- Image format: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP.
- Image size: No more than 10 MB.
- Image resolution: Recommended to be greater than 256 x 256 pixels. Low resolution may affect recognition results.
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

> When the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, please scale the image first. For details, see [Image Scaling](~~44688~~).

## Detection Notes

- The maximum detection time is 5 seconds. If the detection is not completed within this time, the system will return a timeout error code.
- The image download time limit is 3 seconds. If the download time exceeds 3 seconds, the system will return a download timeout.
- The response time of the image detection API depends on the image download time. Please ensure that the storage service hosting the detected images is stable and reliable. We recommend using Alibaba Cloud OSS storage or CDN caching.
- A maximum of 10 images can be detected.
- The liveness detection currently provided by the platform is silent liveness detection, which is based on image analysis. It does not currently support action-based liveness detection such as head shaking, mouth opening, or eye blinking.

## Billing Description
For billing methods and pricing of Face Liveness Detection, see [Billing Overview](~~184049~~).
